description:
**Department:**

 Kolkata / Gurgaon
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Salary:** 
 10\-12 LPA
 



  





**About Triphos** 




 Triphos Power is a full\-stack battery\-as\-a\-service company focused on commercial and industrial (C\&I) customers. We finance, own, deploy, operate, and maintain battery storage systems, backed by our own in\-house Energy Management System (EMS) — putting us at the intersection of system integration, battery portfolio management, and technology. Our target is 100 MWh across 30–40 C\&I sites in Year 1, scaling to a gigawatt\-hour\-plus portfolio within three years. We're backed by the promoter family of Rupa \& Co. and Neo Metaliks, giving us capital strength, distribution expertise, and a warm C\&I customer pipeline from day one.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Every Triphos proposal starts with a number: how much battery a site actually needs, and what it saves the customer. The Sizing Analyst owns that number. You'll work directly with C\&I clients to pull the load, tariff, and consumption data we need, clean it into something usable, and run the sizing and feasibility analysis behind every deal. Your output is the package the customer decides on — a full sizing report, a savings analysis, and a financial model with a clear ROI case. As we push toward 100 MWh across 30–40 sites in Year 1, this analysis is what separates a deal that closes and performs from one that doesn't.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the client data pipeline end to end — work through the data questionnaire with C\&I clients, understand exactly what's needed from each site, and follow up until it lands
* Clean, structure, and validate large, messy client datasets into analysis\-ready inputs
* Run sizing and optimization analysis to determine the right battery configuration for each site
* Determine which use case fits each client best — peak shaving, time\-of\-day arbitrage, renewable integration — based on what the data actually shows
* Research and interpret state tariff orders, electricity bills, penalty structures, and open access regulations to ground every analysis in real numbers
* Build savings analyses that quantify what the customer actually stands to gain
* Produce the full BESS feasibility analysis report for each site
* Communicate directly with clients throughout — chasing data, clarifying assumptions, and keeping the process moving
* Contribute to automating and streamlining the analysis process as we scale



  





**Key Requirements / Skills** 



* 0–3 years of experience
* BSc or higher in Operations Management, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, or a related quantitative field
* Strong expertise in Excel, Python, SQL, or similar analytical tools
* Strong with numbers, with a solid grounding in optimization, statistics, and sharp problem\-solving instincts
* Basic electrical knowledge, or willingness to pick it up quickly



  





**Who We're Looking For** 




 Your analysis drives real investment decisions on both sides, so we want someone who feels that weight and checks their work accordingly.
 


* Meticulous — you go through data line by line because you know what rides on it
* Mathematically sharp, with the instinct to spot a number that looks wrong
* A clear communicator who builds rapport with clients and gets the data you need fast
* Comfortable working directly with C\&I customers
* High ownership and hands\-on, in a small, fast\-moving team



  





**How to Apply** 



* Send your resume and a note under 200 words on why you think you are the right fit to hr@triphospower.com.

title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
hoichoi is India's leading Bengali OTT platform — the digital arm of SVF, Eastern India's largest media \& entertainment company. We stream 650\+ Bengali movies, 185\+ originals, and 3000\+ hours of content to a global audience of \~250 million Bengalis across India, Bangladesh, and 100\+ countries. We're part of a wider ecosystem alongside Sooper (AI\-led micro\-drama OTT) and LoglineAI (AI\-native creative studio), and we're on a mission to entertain everyone in their native language.
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




 We're hiring a Senior Product Analyst to become the first dedicated owner of product analytics at hoichoi. We've been running PostHog for a few months, with real event data flowing across all platforms — what's missing is someone who digs into the data unprompted and turns it into a clear case for what we should change, and why. You'll sit inside the Product \& Data team and work closely with Engineering, Payments, and Programming to move two numbers: revenue and user experience.
 



  





 This is not a reporting service desk. As the first dedicated hire in this function, you will define how it works rather than inherit it. Your output is decisions, not dashboards — finding the exact step where a subscriber drops off, and owning a recommendation through to whether the number actually moved. We want someone who's done this before, checks the data before forming a view, and is comfortable reporting a flat result honestly. This is a full\-time, in\-office role based in Kolkata.
 



  





**What You'll Do**




  





**Drop\-off Analysis** 



* Map every meaningful journey on every platform and find the exact step where users leave: onboarding, login and signup, search, content discovery, playback start, and the subscription funnel.
* Own the subscription funnel end to end — app open → paywall viewed → plan selected → payment initiated → payment success — split by platform, geography, and payment method.
* For every drop\-off found, report how many users and how much revenue it costs, why it's happening, and what specifically should change.
* Analyse payment failures and retry behaviour alongside the payments team.
* Track whether each recommended fix moved the number, and report plainly if it didn't.



**Retention, Churn \& Cohorts** 



* Build and maintain retention and cohort views — day\-1/7/30, trial\-to\-paid, renewal, and cancellation.
* Identify first\-session and first\-week behaviours that predict a subscriber sticking around, and recommend how to engineer more of them.



**Content \& Programming Analytics** 



* Report on content performance — tray impressions and clicks, play starts, completion rates, drop\-off curves, and search behaviour.
* Feed insights back to the programming team on what to promote, tray order, and whether an underperforming release was a content or merchandising issue.
* Support the internal Programming Analyst tooling built on top of PostHog.



**Experimentation** 



* Set up and read A/B tests and feature\-flag rollouts in PostHog — paywall variants, onboarding flows, tray layouts.
* Define success metrics and guardrail metrics up front, and call results honestly, including flat ones.



**Reporting Rhythm** 



* Run a weekly product metrics review that people actually read, and a monthly deep dive on one problem area of your choosing.
* Deliver release\-impact analysis after every major app release.



  





**Must\-Have Qualifications :** 



* 4–6 years in product analytics, growth analytics, or data analysis on a consumer (B2C) product — app or web — including experience mentoring or setting standards for others.
* Hands\-on ownership of a product analytics tool (PostHog, Mixpanel, Amplitude, CleverTap, or similar) — has defined events, built funnels, and debugged bad data, not just consumed dashboards someone else built.
* Demonstrated ability to find drop\-offs and act on them, with a concrete example of a funnel fixed, what was found, what changed, and what it was worth.
* Solid grasp of funnels, cohorts, retention curves, and segmentation.
* Comfortable working with AI tooling day to day — specifically the PostHog MCP server with Claude — and able to get MCP running within a week if new to it.
* Willing to check the data and then take a decision: form a view, recommend it clearly, and own the outcome.
* Able to write a clear recommendation — what the data says, what to do about it, and how confident to be.
* Self\-directed, arriving with questions rather than waiting for answers.



  





  





**Candidates must have experience in any product analytics tool: PostHog, Mixpanel, Amplitude, CleverTap or similar.** 




  





**Why Join hoichoi** 




 You'll be the first dedicated product analytics hire at India's leading Bengali OTT platform — defining how the function works rather than inheriting someone else's playbook, with real event data across six platforms from day one. Every recommendation you make has a direct line to revenue and to how millions of viewers experience the product. hoichoi is going all\-in on becoming AI\-native, so you'll work daily with the PostHog MCP server and Claude as part of your core workflow, with a clear path to owning a growing analytics function as it scales.
 



  





**Culture \& How We Work** 




 At hoichoi, the best idea wins, not the biggest title. We operate in small, cross\-functional teams that argue productively and ship fast. Ownership isn't a buzzword here; it's the default setting — if something's broken, you fix it rather than filing a ticket and waiting.
 



  





 We ship fast, measure what works, and iterate. Some releases — particularly TV platform and store submissions — land outside standard hours, and we expect flexibility around those windows. We're equally serious about keeping the pace sustainable the rest of the time.

 This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to Twinings ambitious Sourced with Care programme and drive tangible, positive and sustainable impact in its supply chain in the region. The role focuses on issues above and beyond the ones traditionally covered by social audits and have a specific focus on by assessing conditions, driving improvements, and supporting the day\-to\-day implementation of tailored projects to improve the quality of life in sourcing communities, including gender, living conditions, livelihoods, health, and nutrition.

If you have the experience and drive to develop within ethical sourcing management, we encourage you to apply.
   

  

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Monitoring and improvements** 
* Organise and conduct needs assessments in sourcing communities in the region against the social criteria defined in the assessment tools (TCNA) by engaging with local communities and relevant stakeholders to identify their needs, priorities in a participatory manner.
* Prepare detailed assessment reports, including scoring and substantiated with evidence to provide clear information to Twinings and producers.
* Identify all key potential social and environmental impacts and risks existing in the system and ensure that their magnitude and significance are understood by the internal stakeholders. Work with Twinings Senior Social Impact Manager and producer groups to agree improvement plan and next actions and keep the internal stakeholders updated.
* Follow up on the progress of suppliers’ improvements against the action plan in a timely manner.
* Build supply chain knowledge in the region (eg: mapping smallholders).


**Projects** 
* Support the day\-to\-day implementation and monitoring of projects in the region.
* Identify needs and support the development and rollout of training/support programme for sites/producers.
* Support global projects or advise on issues across the supply chain (for example on GBV, health and wellbeing, carbon footprint etc.).

* Participating, as required, in relevant industry bodies, acting as Twinings representative.
* Keep up to date on current industry SI\&S initiatives and best practices.


**Communication and reporting / M\&E** 
* Working with partners and producers to track Sourced with Care KPIs in a timely, effective, and accurate manner, and help measure our impact (including financial resilience and women’s empowerment).
* Reporting on sites ethical performances to internal stakeholders (Head of Social Impact, Senior leadership, buyers)
* Contribute to good quality content gathering and comms activities (case studies, pictures, videos, articles, etc.)
* Effective use of the Twinings Ethical database and other tools to track and analyse records of conditions on tea estates and agreed KPIs.
* Provide additional support as needed for reporting activities.

* Support with general administrative tasks as well as team systems and processes.
* Support employee engagement initiatives, as needed (internal presentation, newsletter article, employees field visit, etc).

* Previous experience of conducting Community\-based participatory research or needs assessments

The organization connects four key business areas: digital media and marketing, edTech, IT\-enabled services, mobile app and web app development. Over the past 20 years, the company has grown through future\-focused thinking, strategic execution, and wise investment in technology and talent. Mind \& Matter showcases all its businesses under one umbrella brand, emphasizing global capabilities, local focus, and a unified culture. Applicants can explore individual business lines via their LinkedIn company pages to understand the breadth of services and opportunities.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 As a Business Analyst (Customer Solution \& Requirements), you will serve as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams. You will lead customer discovery sessions to uncover operational challenges, translate business needs into detailed functional specifications, and ensure delivered software solutions align directly with customer goals while minimizing scope creep and rework.
 



  





**Role Outcomes** 



* Client onboarding transitions smoothly from signed contract into discovery, scope baselines, and implementation roadmaps.
* Drive and ownership of Client business goals being accurately translated into structured BRDs, FRDs, and SRS documents that drive the end\-to\-end Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Engineering, UI/UX, and QA teams receive production\-ready user stories, system workflows, business logic, and acceptance criteria across all development sprints.
* Scope creep and requirement churn are proactively controlled through formal change management and continuous client communication.
* User Acceptance Testing (UAT) achieves fast, structured sign\-offs with direct traceability to the agreed functional specifications.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Discovery \& Client Stakeholder Management** 



* Lead post\-sales requirement workshops, discovery, kickoff sessions, and recurring discovery meetings with client\-side product owners, department heads, and end users.
* Uncover operational challenges, target workflows, and critical success factors; translate contractual scope into realistic functional deliverables.
* Capture detailed meeting minutes, decisions, system dependencies, assumptions, and risk items, obtaining formal client sign\-off.
* Serve as the primary post\-sales functional liaison between the client and internal technical delivery teams.



**Requirement Engineering (BRD, FRD, SRS \& Process Modeling)** 



* Create end\-to\-end
 **Business Requirements Documents (BRD)** 
 detailing business objectives, high\-level scope, user roles, and operational constraints.
* Formulate exhaustive
 **Functional Requirements Documents (FRD)** 
 specifying UI behavior, validations, error handling, system logic, and data structures.
* Develop and maintain
 **Software Requirements Specifications (SRS)** 
 inputs, covering non\-functional requirements, external interfaces, and system interaction constraints.
* Map current client operations (As\-Is) to proposed platform capabilities (To\-Be) using diagrams, process models, and data flow diagrams.
* Maintain a live
 **Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM)** 
 linking each business objective through FRD/SRS specifications, sprint backlog items, test cases, and deployment.



**Sprint Execution \& Software Life Cycle (SDLC) Enablement** 



* Own functional grooming throughout the Agile/Scrum delivery lifecycle, breaking down FRDs and SRS items into well\-structured user stories with clear Given\-When\-Then acceptance criteria.
* Drive the Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, and Sprint Reviews to ensure engineering and QA teams understand functional nuances before development begins.
* Provide continuous, in\-sprint functional support to resolve blockers, clarify ambiguous edge cases, and validate work\-in\-progress features.
* Enforce change request procedures by evaluating the scope, cost, sprint velocity, and schedule impact of new client feature requests.



**User Acceptance Testing (UAT), Go\-Live \& Handover** 



* Formulate UAT plans, test scenarios, and acceptance checklists aligned with the signed FRD/SRS.
* Coordinate UAT execution directly with client business users, triaging reported defects to distinguish genuine functional bugs from new out\-of\-scope change requests.
* Guide clients through release demos, product walkthroughs, and end\-user enablement sessions to secure formal project sign\-off.
* Support post\-launch rollout, deployment and functional knowledge transfer to the ongoing client support team.



  





**Expected Deliverables** 



* Client Discovery Agenda, Stakeholder Map, and Meeting Action Logs
* As\-Is \& To\-Be Process Flowcharts and Data Flow Diagrams
* Business Requirements Document (BRD)
* Functional Requirements Document (FRD)
* Software Requirements Specification (SRS) inputs
* Sprint\-Ready User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, and Edge\-Case Matrices
* Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM)
* Change Request Logs with Scope and Timeline Impact Assessments
* UAT Test Scripts, Defect Logs, and Client Acceptance Sign\-Off Records



  





**Qualifications and Experience** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or Engineering.
* **1–2 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Functional Analyst, or Solution Analyst in a post\-sales, software solution development or SaaS implementation environment.**
* Hands\-on experience drafting formal
 **BRD, FRD, and SRS** 
 documentation, as well as managing sprint backlogs in Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.
* Solid understanding of the complete
 **Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)** 
 and Agile/Scrum execution practices.
* Proven track record of independently facilitating workshops and managing client expectations across multiple post\-sales engagements.
* Exceptional written, verbal, and stakeholder presentation skills.

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are looking for a Senior Consultant specializing in
 **SAP EHSM (Environment, Health \& Safety Management)** 
 within the S/4HANA framework. This role focuses on modern safety processes such as Incident Management, Risk Assessment, Workplace Safety, Management of Change (MoC), and Safety Observations. You will work with advanced EHS capabilities including AI\-driven safety instructions, risk analytics, and modular EHS components.
   

  

 You will participate in requirement analysis, solution design, configuration, testing, documentation, and deployment of SAP Environment, Health \& Safety (EHS) and Safety Management (EHSM) modules, ensuring high\-quality delivery in line with EY standards.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 As a Senior Consultant, you will take ownership of key deliverables within workstreams and support client engagements across the project lifecycle.
   

  

**Project \& Delivery Responsibilities**
* Support end\-to\-end delivery of SAP EHS/EHSM workstreams including requirements gathering, blueprinting, design, configuration, testing, and deployment.
* Conduct functional workshops with business stakeholders to understand EHS processes, compliance needs, and risk management requirements.
* Translate business requirements into functional specifications and system configurations.
* Assist in designing SAP EHS/EHSM solutions across modules such as:
+ Product Safety \& Compliance (PS)
+ Industrial Hygiene \& Safety (IH\&S)
+ Occupational Health
+ Incident/Accident Management
+ Risk Assessment \& Controls
+ Environment Management
+ Management of Change (MoC)

* Collaborate with technical teams for WRICEF development and integrations with SAP and non\-SAP systems.
* Execute unit testing, system integration testing, UAT support, and deployment readiness.
* Create and maintain project documentation including PDDs, BPPs, configuration guides, and test scripts.


**Stakeholder Management**
* Work directly with client users, super\-users, and business SMEs for issue resolution and requirement clarifications.
* Support client training sessions and user enablement during deployment.


**Support \& Enhancements**
* Provide SAP EHS/EHSM application support, troubleshoot issues, and drive continuous improvements.
* Analyze system gaps, propose optimized solutions, and ensure alignment with S/4HANA best practices.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities to address complex functional requirements.
* Ability to work independently on assigned deliverables and collaborate effectively in a hybrid (onshore–offshore) team.
* Clear communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to engage directly with clients.
* Strong documentation discipline and adherence to project governance standards.
* Ability to manage time, prioritize tasks, and work under minimal supervision.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Hands\-on configuration experience in SAP EHS/EHSM components:
* Hazardous Substance Management
* Safety Data Sheet (SDS) Management
* Dangerous Goods Management
* Incident/Accident Reporting
* Risk Assessments, Controls \& Mitigation
* Good understanding of regulatory compliance standards (OSHA, REACH, GHS, ISO 45001, etc.)
* Knowledge of SAP EHS master data and integration with:
* SAP MM / PP / QM / PM
* SAP Environment, Health \& Safety Management (EHSM) submodules
* Experience in S/4HANA EHS architecture and Fiori applications.
* Experience in preparing functional specifications for enhancements, reports, workflows, and interfaces.
* Exposure to SAP EHS mobile applications or third\-party EHS tool integration is an added advantage.


**What We Look For**
* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) Preferably Engineering
* 4–6 years of SAP EHSM / Workplace Safety experience.
* At least one complete EHS/EHSM implementation plus support/enhancement experience.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
